<parameter name="content"># Claude Code context layout for `atlas`

Principle: always-needed, short facts go in CLAUDE.md files, scoped by directory. Deterministic guarantees go in hooks or permissions. Long, occasionally needed procedures go in skills. External systems go through MCP.

## Files and mechanisms

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | Always-loaded memory | Holds only org-wide conventions (conventional commits, `make check` before PR, trunk-based) plus pointers to the service dirs; every session needs these. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md (loads when Claude works in `api/`) | Carries the `api/gen/` "generated by `make proto`, never hand-edit" rule, so Go context does not cost tokens in web or pipeline sessions. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Carries "`npm test` launches real Playwright browsers; use `npm run test:unit`", relevant only to web work. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Carries "set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs", relevant only to pipeline work. |
| `.claude/settings.json` + `PreToolUse` hook on Edit/Write for `api/gen/**` | Hook | The CLAUDE.md note is advisory, but silent overwrites are costly, so a hook that blocks edits and says "run `make proto`" makes it deterministic. |
| `.claude/settings.json` permissions | Permissions (`deny`/`ask`) | Optionally `ask` on bare `npm test` in `web/` so the browser-launching command is never run by accident. |
| `.claude/skills/incident-response/SKILL.md` | Skill (ideally shipped via a company-wide plugin) | The 20-step runbook is long, identical for every team, and only needed during incidents, so on-demand loading keeps it out of every session's context. A plugin avoids copies drifting between repos. |
| `.mcp.json` (project scope) with a warehouse MCP server | MCP server | Live SQL against the analytics warehouse needs a tool connection, not prose. Use a read-only warehouse role and reference credentials via environment variables, never committed values. |
| `.claude/settings.json` permissions for the warehouse MCP tools | Permissions | Allow only the read/query tools and deny anything mutating, so analyst use stays safe. |
| Managed/org-level CLAUDE.md (optional) | Managed policy memory | If the three shared conventions apply to every repo at the company, set them once centrally and keep the root file thinner. |
| `CLAUDE.local.md` / `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal memory (gitignored/user-level) | Individual preferences stay out of the shared repo files. |

## Deliberately NOT done

- The runbook is not inlined in any CLAUDE.md: 20 steps of rarely used text would be paid for in every session.
- The warehouse is not reached through shell scripts with embedded credentials; MCP with scoped permissions is auditable.
- Service quirks are not in the root file; they would add noise to unrelated sessions.
- Nothing here duplicates what the code already shows (directory trees, language basics).

## Open items to confirm with the team

- Which warehouse (and which MCP server implementation) you use, and that a read-only role exists.
- Whether a company plugin marketplace exists for distributing the runbook skill.
- Exact hook script location (e.g. `.claude/hooks/block-gen-edits.sh`) and its tests.

<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services:

- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

Service-specific rules live in `api/CLAUDE.md`, `web/CLAUDE.md`, and `pipeline/CLAUDE.md`; they load when you work in those directories.

## Conventions (all services)

- Use conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches only, no long-lived branches.

## Other context

- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill; do not improvise the runbook.
- Product metrics: query the analytics warehouse through the warehouse MCP tools (read-only).
